appInfoLoading: App info is still loading. Try again shortly.
autoStartHint: Starts in the tray without opening the main window.
catalogEmptyHint: Use the button above to fetch the list from upstream
deepseekBaseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the official DeepSeek API. For self-hosted deployments, enter your OpenAI-compatible endpoint, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
deepseekTransportHint: Default transport for every upstream. Select Chat API compatibility when the upstream does not implement the Responses API or a request requires a CodeSeeX-owned local tool executor.
webSearchBackendHint: Local keeps CodeSeeX's bounded search. Official lets DeepSeek search server-side and may use more tokens. CodeSeeX uses only the selected backend; a request that also needs local tools must use Local or Chat compatibility.
releaseNotesUnavailable: Release notes are unavailable right now.
releaseNotesNoEntries: No release notes are available for this version.
releaseNotesOfflineFallback: Showing cached or included release notes because GitHub is unavailable.
releaseNotesLanguageFallback: This release is currently available in English.
codexAdapterMissing: Codex adapter catalog is not ready.
codexLaunchExperimentalDetail: Opening Codex with experimental model list injection...
codexLaunchStartedWithInjection: Codex launch requested with model list injection.
codexLaunchStartedWithInjectionWarning: Codex opened, but experimental model list injection did not complete.
ccsImportStartedCatalogWarning: CCS import opened. We still recommend copying the CodeSeeX TOML directly instead of relying on CCS import to keep the model catalog; CCS may show the catalog in preview but drop it after saving.
ccsApiKeyHint: Paste the real API key CCS needs for validation. CodeSeeX includes it only in this one import link and does not save it.
ccsApiKeyCatalogWarning: Copy the CodeSeeX TOML directly instead of relying on CCS import to keep the model catalog. CCS may show the catalog in preview but drop it after saving.
troubleshootActionActiveRequests: {count} request(s) are still running. Wait before restarting unless the request is stuck.
troubleshootActionCatalogProblem: The Codex model catalog is missing, damaged, or not referenced by the TOML. Copy the TOML again or regenerate the adapter.
troubleshootActionCatalogRepaired: CodeSeeX regenerated the Codex model catalog. Copy the TOML again if Codex was already open.
troubleshootActionHealthy: The local proxy looks healthy. If Codex still fails, copy the TOML again and restart Codex.
troubleshootActionPortConflict: If startup fails, another process may occupy this port. Stop the other service or change the CodeSeeX listen port.
troubleshootActionRefreshStatus: Refresh status after changing ports, closing old processes, or reinstalling.
troubleshootActionRestartNeeded: A saved proxy setting changed. Restart the proxy to apply it.
troubleshootActionRuntimeCatalogProblem: Codex runtime did not return the CodeSeeX model catalog. Copy the TOML from CodeSeeX, fully restart Codex, then verify again.
troubleshootActionRuntimeCatalogUnavaila: CodeSeeX could not verify Codex runtime through app-server. Make sure the Codex CLI is installed, then retry.
troubleshootActionStartProxy: Start the proxy, then copy the latest TOML if Codex still points to an old config.
troubleshootActionWaitStartup: The proxy is still starting. Wait a moment, then refresh this check.
troubleshootHint: Review the key states; expand technical details only when you need paths or model lists.
catalogNotCheckedHint: Adapter information has not been generated yet.
catalogNoticeError: Codex model catalog is missing or damaged. CodeSeeX could not confirm a valid catalog; regenerate the adapter or copy the TOML again.
catalogNoticeRepaired: CodeSeeX regenerated the Codex model catalog. If Codex is already open, copy the TOML again and restart Codex.
catalogNoticeRuntimeError: Codex runtime did not load the CodeSeeX model catalog. Copy the TOML from CodeSeeX and restart Codex.
catalogNoticeWarning: Codex model catalog needs attention. Check Troubleshoot before relying on the Codex model list.
catalogRuntimeCheckingHint: Reading the Codex runtime model list through app-server.
catalogRuntimeErrorHint: Codex runtime did not return CodeSeeX models. Copy the TOML again and restart Codex.
catalogRuntimeHint: Verify on demand whether Codex runtime actually read the model catalog.
catalogRuntimeUnavailableHint: CodeSeeX could not start or connect to Codex app-server; this does not necessarily mean the catalog is broken.

toolResult: Tool result returned to the model.
networkProxyModeHint: Used by upstream requests, Web Search, Vision, and update checks. Restart the proxy after changing it.

viewAboutSubtitle: Version info, data paths, and future extension notes.
viewConfigSubtitle: Transparent local app settings. Changes are autosaved; some proxy settings require a manual restart.
viewConsoleSubtitle: Check balance, proxy state, and Codex TOML before using Codex.
viewLogsSubtitle: Clean user-level runtime events; usage detail stays in Usage.
viewUsageSubtitle: Review completed conversation records, token usage, latency, and estimated cost.
codexAppModelListInjectionHint: Experimental and enabled by default. Launch Codex also tries to patch the Codex App renderer model list; turn it off if Codex App compatibility changes.
reasoningSummaryHint: Only decides how much of the thinking chain appears in the Codex window. The upstream model keeps thinking exactly as before, the conversation still continues, and nothing here changes the request sent to the model.
toolApplyPatchDescription: Native Codex patch editor for precise file changes. This system tool follows Codex settings.
toolWebSearchDescription: Search the web and open public pages with the configured network proxy policy.
toolMcpServerDescription: Use MCP tools discovered by Codex. Server configuration stays in Codex.
toolListDirectoryDescription: Browse workspace folders with depth limits, filters, and compact metadata.
toolReadFileRangeDescription: Read selected UTF-8 text lines from workspace files. Images and binary files are rejected.
toolWorkspaceSearchDescription: Find text across workspace files with include/exclude filters and line matches.
toolVisionAnalyzeDescription: Inspect images with DeepSeek Vision or a custom OpenAI-compatible image understanding endpoint.
toolVisionGenerateDescription: Generate images through a separately configured image generation endpoint.
visionAnalyzeBackendHint: DeepSeek Vision uses the official Responses API. Custom model keeps the existing OpenAI-compatible endpoint path.
visionImageDetailHint: DeepSeek currently treats Auto as Original. Low is suitable for simpler inspection and may reduce image processing cost.
visionDeepSeekModelHint: Leave empty to use the built-in image understanding model. The dedicated image model is never added to the main Agent model catalog.
visionAnalyzeRequestUrlHint: Complete OpenAI-compatible image understanding endpoint. Local image pixels are sent to this endpoint.
visionAnalyzeModelHint: Model name sent to the Vision analyze endpoint.
visionAnalyzeApiKeyHint: Bearer token used only by the custom image understanding endpoint.
visionGenerateRequestUrlHint: Complete OpenAI-compatible image generation endpoint. Prefer /responses; use /images/generations only for the official image-model API.
visionGenerateModelHint: Model name sent to the Vision image generation endpoint.
visionGenerateApiKeyHint: Bearer token used only by the image generation endpoint.
dashboardBalanceSubtitle: Balance, local proxy state, and Codex connection config.
usageFoldedHint: Each row is a user conversation or service request; expand to inspect model, tool, final reply, cache, and cost stages.
usageCompletedFinalResponse: Completed and returned to the client
usageBillableFailedRequest: Usage was billed, but the request did not finish
usageClientToolHandoff: Model asked the client to continue tool execution
usageVisionCompleted: Vision result returned to the model
usageToolCompleted: Tool result returned to the model
logCleanHint: Safe diagnostics timeline for requests, tools, context, protocol, and network events.
aboutProductDescription: Local Codex bridge with a desktop manager, proxy, catalog, and tool controls.
aboutFooterNote: Connect Codex to the configured model service through the local desktop manager. Use valid API credentials and follow the provider terms.
websiteUnavailable: No official website URL is configured for this version.
